name: Sensesemi Technologies Pvt Ltd
india_angle: Sensesemi Technologies Pvt Ltd is based in India, focusing on developing advanced SoC solutions for IoT and IoMT applications.
summary: Sensesemi Technologies Pvt Ltd specializes in the design and development of System-on-a-Chip (SoC) solutions with a focus on ultra-low power consumption and embedded AI capabilities. Their products are aimed at revolutionizing the Internet of Things (IoT) and Internet of Medical Things (IoMT) markets by providing efficient and secure wireless communication solutions.
